covered: setup writes only the non-secret configuration and a hash-only ACL; the password is only in the keyring, never in a file or the container's arguments
the container is created from the approved configuration with a 1 GiB cap, AOF on and noeviction; one with other settings is never adopted
without the password nothing can be read; the memory user cannot run administrative commands or touch keys outside omem:*
the Gateway marks an empty store as its resource, refuses another resource and refuses unmarked data
a confirmed write survives a container kill
leases fence an old holder; versions move one at a time; a retry appends nothing; a different change under one key conflicts
an event whose fsync was never confirmed is not served until a later confirmed one covers it
list cursors work only for the project, scope and key that issued them; any holder of the Gateway key can name any project (pinned residual)
checkpoints are kept once and served newest first; the writer is one connection without retries
